levels.2: passing isolated unit or differential tests
levels.4: verified against the original DOS executable in a stated domain (three-way, scenario level)

notes: Levels are the highest level reached inside the stated domain; a subsystem can be level 2 for isolated routines and still level 5 at scenario level. Both are given.

Scenario checks run natively against references recorded once per DOS executable (build/reference/, portable/tests/acceptance/step_check.py, seconds per scenario). Native replays each DOS run's own per-site clock values and its chronological service order (clock reads, BIOS keyboard samples, queue-count samples, pumps, simulation boundaries); each recorded input is admitted at its recorded service position through the ordinary SDL adapter. The canonical lane (native vs canonical DOS) tests the port, the original lane tests the whole chain. Verdicts are game state per DoAntSim entry.

scenarios.new-game-save (64 entries): original lane equal through 38, canonical through 35; first difference window_current_event Event.v of a queued keyboard-IRQ Enter (FA1Ch): DOS holds the interrupted DX, native 0 (platform.json native-input-hardware-context). 8-entry prefixes equal.
scenarios.quick-game (2000 entries): original lane equal through 658, canonical through 659; first difference the same keyboard-IRQ Event.v (interrupted DX). 8-entry prefixes equal.
scenarios.long-run (3000 entries, unattended): equal in game state for all 3000 entries in both lanes (original and canonical): native = original DOS and native = canonical DOS, about 10 s per lane.
scenarios.original repeatability: original recorded twice: all 307 SaveRec records equal at every entry in all three scenarios; quick-game window_current_event differs from entry 1703 between repeats (observation setup differed; cause not isolated)

finish_line: Port verified faithful for normal play when every corpus scenario (new-game-save, quick-game, an unattended long run, load-from-save, experiment mode) is equal three ways in game state for its whole step count, frames and sound streams are compared at checkpoints, and the native check of all scenarios runs in under a minute as part of the port suites.
